technology_name: MULTI-STAGE PARALLEL DESALINATION SYSTEM WITH INTEGRATED THERMAL MANAGEMENT FOR WASTE HEAT RECOVERY AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Thermal processing plants release vast quantities of volatile stack gases and high-temperature steam directly into ambient airways, wasting recoverable clean energy.
description: An advanced multi-stage parallel desalination plant integration equipped with built-in phase change material (PCM) modules, specialized vapor evaporation loops, and localized cooling nodes to capture industrial thermal waste outputs.
applications: Thermal power generation facility upgrades, manufacturing plant cooling loop integrations, smart city sustainable utility systems, and chemical factory energy recovery networks.
